7: KHLESTAKOV. Why go to so much trouble? However, there is the ink. I don't know whether there is any paper. Would the bill do?
5: GOVERNOR [aside, to Dobchinsky]. Listen. Run as fast as you can and take two notes, one to Zemlianika at the hospital, the other to my wife. [To Khlestakov.] May I take the liberty of asking you to permit me to write a line to my wife to tell her to make ready to receive our honored guest?
4: GOVERNOR [to Dobchinsky]. Now there'll be no room for you, Piotr Ivanovich. DOBCHINSKY. It doesn't matter. I'll walk.
